sections.section: RULE - Income-Tax (Computation of Export Profits and the Tax Attributable to Export Sales) Rules 1977

INCOME‑TAX
(COMPUTATION OF EXPORT PROFITS AND THE TAX ATTRIBUTABLE TO EXPORT SALES) RULES,
1977
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II, 2nd .July 1977]
S. R. O. 572 (I)/77.‑In
exercise of the powers conferred by clause (d) of subsection (4) of section 3
of the Finance Act, 1977, the Central Board of Revenue hereby makes the
following rules, namely :‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑(1) These rules may
be called the Income‑tax (Computation of Export Profits and the Tax
Attributable to Export Sales) Rules, 1977.
(2) They shall come into force
on the first day of July 1977.
2. Definitions.‑In these
Rules, unit as there is anything repugnant in the subject or context,‑
(a) "export sales"
means‑
(i) the ex‑factory p; ice
of goods, where such goods, exported out of Pakistan were manufactured by the
exporter; and
(ii) the ex‑godown price
of the goods exported out of Pakistan, in other cases; and
(b) '`total sales" means
the aggregate of export sales as determined under clause (a) and
(i) the ex‑factory price
of goods sold in Pakistan, where the goods exported out of Pakistan were
manufactured by the exporter, or
(ii) the ex‑godown price
of goods sold in Pakistan, is other cases.
3. Computation of export
profits.‑Where an assessee exports any goods manufactured in Pakistan,
his profits attributable to export sales of such goods shall be computed in the
manner specified hereunder : ‑
(a) Where an agsessee maintains
separate accounts of the business of export of goods manufactured in Pakistan,
the profits of the export business shall be taken to be such amount as may be
determined by the Income‑tax Officer in accordance with the provisions of
the Income‑tax Act, 1922 (XI of 1922), on the basis of such accounts;
(b) in other cases, the profits
of such business shall be taken to be an amount which bears to the total
profits of the business of the assessee from the sale of goods, the same
proportion as the export sales of goods manu factured in Pakistan bear to the
total sates of goods.
4. Computation of tax attributable to export sales.‑Where
the total income of an assessee includes any profits from export of goods
manufactured in Pakistan, the tai attributable to such profits shall be an
amount which bears to the tax payable on the total income the same proportion
as such profits bear to the total income.
[C. No. 13 (69) ITI/76].
